questions.en: At which historic confluence in Bihar does the River Gandak discharge into the River Ganga, celebrated for the annual Harihar Kshetra Sonepur fair?
questions.hi: बिहार के किस ऐतिहासिक संगम पर गंडक नदी गंगा में विसर्जित होती है, जो वार्षिक हरिहर क्षेत्र सोनपुर मेले के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Gandak merges into the left bank of the Ganga at Sonpur (Saran) opposite Hajipur (Vaishali), the site of the world-famous Harihar Kshetra Sonepur Mela, Asia's largest cattle fair held on Kartik Purnima.
questions.tip: Gandak meets Ganga at Sonpur/Hajipur; Son meets Ganga at Maner/Danapur; Punpun meets Ganga at Fatuha.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The गंडक नदी merges into the left bank of the गंगा नदी at Sonpur (Saran) opposite Hajipur (Vaishali), the site of the world-famous Harihar Kshetra Sonepur Mela, Asia's largest cattle fair held on Kartik Purnima.
questions.tip_hi: गंडक नदी meets गंगा नदी at Sonpur/Hajipur; सोन नदी meets गंगा नदी at Maner/Danapur; Punpun meets गंगा नदी at Fatuha.

questions.en: The fertile alluvial soil in the floodplains of North Bihar that is renewed every year by river inundation is known as
questions.hi: उत्तर बिहार के बाढ़ के मैदानों में प्रतिवर्ष नदियों द्वारा नवीनीकृत होने वाली उपजाऊ जलोढ़ मिट्टी क्या कहलाती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Khadar is new alluvium deposited annually by monsoon floodwaters in low-lying river plains (Gandak, Kosi, Bagmati), highly fertile and rich in fine silt. Bangar represents older alluvium situated in upland terraces above flood level.
questions.tip: New flood alluvium = Khadar (highly fertile); Older upland alluvium = Bangar (contains kankar nodules).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Khadar is new alluvium deposited annually by monsoon floodwaters in low-lying river plains (गंडक नदी, कोसी नदी, Bagmati), highly fertile and rich in fine silt. Bangar represents older alluvium situated in upland terraces above flood level.
questions.tip_hi: New flood alluvium = Khadar (highly fertile); Older upland alluvium = Bangar (contains kankar nodules).

questions.en: Guru Shikhar, with an elevation of 1,722 metres on Mount Abu, is the highest mountain peak of which ancient fold mountain range?
questions.hi: माउंट आबू पर 1,722 मीटर ऊँचाई वाला गुरु शिखर किस प्राचीन वलित पर्वत श्रृंखला की सबसे ऊँची चोटी है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) in the Arbuda Mountains of Rajasthan is the highest peak of the Aravalli Range, one of the oldest residual fold mountain systems in the world.
questions.tip: Aravalli highest peak = Guru Shikhar (1,722 m); Satpura highest peak = Dhupgarh (1,350 m).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) in the Arbuda Mountains of Rajasthan is the highest peak of the Aravalli Range, one of the oldest residual fold mountain systems in the world.
questions.tip_hi: Aravalli highest peak = Guru Shikhar (1,722 m); Satpura highest peak = Dhupgarh (1,350 m).

questions.en: Which river island formed by the Brahmaputra River in Assam is recognized as the world's largest inhabited river island?
questions.hi: असम में ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी द्वारा निर्मित कौन-सा नदी द्वीप विश्व का सबसे बड़ा आबाद नदी द्वीप माना जाता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Majuli island, formed by the Brahmaputra River and its anabranch Kherkutia Xuti joined by the Subansiri River, is a designated district of Assam and the world's largest river island according to Guinness World Records.
questions.tip: Largest river island = Majuli (Brahmaputra, Assam); Smallest inhabited river island = Umananda (Peacock Island, Guwahati).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Majuli island, formed by the Brahmaputra River and its anabranch Kherkutia Xuti joined by the Subansiri River, is a designated district of Assam and the world's largest river island according to Guinness World Records.
questions.tip_hi: Largest river island = Majuli (Brahmaputra, Assam); Smallest inhabited river island = Umananda (Peacock Island, Guwahati).

questions.en: Who served as the first elected President of the Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (BPKS) established in November 1929 at the Sonepur Fair?(
questions.hi: नवंबर 1929 में सोनपुर मेले के दौरान स्थापित 'बिहार प्रांतीय किसान सभा' (BPKS) के प्रथम निर्वाचित अध्यक्ष कौन थे?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati established the BPKS at Sonepur in November 1929 to protect tenant farmers from zamindari eviction. He was elected President, and Dr. Sri Krishna Singh was appointed Secretary.
questions.tip: Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (1929, Sonepur) = President: Swami Sahajanand Saraswati; Secretary: Sri Krishna Singh.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती established the BPKS at Sonepur in नवम्बर 1929 to protect tenant farmers from zamindari eviction. He was elected राष्ट्रपति, and Dr. Sri Krishna Singh was appointed Secretary.
questions.tip_hi: Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha (1929, Sonepur) = राष्ट्रपति: स्वामी सहजानंद सरस्वती; Secretary: Sri Krishna Singh.

questions.en: During the pre-monsoon summer months of May and June, the extremely hot, dry, and dust-laden westerly winds blowing across the Bihar plains are known as
questions.hi: मई और जून के गर्मियों के महीनों में बिहार के मैदानों में चलने वाली अत्यधिक गर्म, शुष्क और धूल भरी पछुआ हवाएं क्या कहलाती हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'Loo' is the strong, scorching dry summer wind blowing from the Thar Desert eastward across northern India and Bihar during afternoon hours, causing heatstroke. Norwesters (Kalbaishakhi) are thunderstorm showers.
questions.tip: Hot dry summer wind = Loo; Thunderstorm pre-monsoon rain = Kalbaishakhi (Norwesters).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: 'Loo' is the strong, scorching dry summer wind blowing from the Thar Desert eastward across northern India and Bihar के दौरान afternoon घंटे, causing heatstroke. Norwesters (Kalbaishakhi) are thunderstorm showers.
questions.tip_hi: Hot dry summer wind = Loo; Thunderstorm pre-monsoon rain = Kalbaishakhi (Norwesters).

questions.en: Which is the highest mountain peak in the Eastern Ghats of India?
questions.hi: भारत के पूर्वी घाट की सबसे ऊँची पर्वत चोटी कौन-सी है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Jindhagada Peak (also known as Arma Konda) in the Araku Valley of Andhra Pradesh has an elevation of 1,690 metres, making it the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats. Mahendragiri (1,501 m) is in Odisha.
questions.tip: Highest of Eastern Ghats = Jindhagada / Arma Konda (1,690 m); Highest of Western Ghats = Anamudi (2,695 m).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Jindhagada Peak (also के रूप में जाना जाता है Arma Konda) in the Araku Valley of Andhra Pradesh has an elevation of 1,690 metres, making it the highest peak of the Eastern Ghats. Mahendragiri (1,501 m) is in Odisha.
questions.tip_hi: Highest of Eastern Ghats = Jindhagada / Arma Konda (1,690 m); Highest of Western Ghats = Anamudi (2,695 m).

questions.en: The River Punpun, an important right-bank tributary originating in the Palamu plateau of Jharkhand, discharges into the River Ganga at which town in Bihar?
questions.hi: झारखंड के पलामू पठार से निकलने वाली गंगा की प्रमुख दाहिनी सहायक नदी 'पुनपुन' बिहार के किस नगर में गंगा में विसर्जित होती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Punpun River flows northeast through Aurangabad, Arwal, and Patna districts and joins the right bank of the Ganga at Fatuha, approximately 25 km downstream of Patna.
questions.tip: Punpun joins Ganga at Fatuha; Son joins Ganga at Danapur/Maner; Gandak joins at Sonpur.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Punpun River flows northeast through Aurangabad, Arwal, and Patna districts and joins the right bank of the गंगा नदी at Fatuha, approximately 25 किमी downstream of Patna.
questions.tip_hi: Punpun joins गंगा नदी at Fatuha; सोन नदी joins गंगा नदी at Danapur/Maner; गंडक नदी joins at Sonpur.

questions.en: The historic 'Son Canal System', the oldest canal irrigation network in Bihar, was inaugurated in which year with its headworks at Dehri-on-Son?
questions.hi: बिहार का सबसे पुराना नहर सिंचाई नेटवर्क 'सोन नहर प्रणाली' किस वर्ष देहरी-ऑन-सोन में अपने हेडवर्क्स के साथ शुरू किया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Son Canal System was completed in 1874 by constructing an anicut weir across the Son River at Dehri (Rohtas). It bifurcates into the Western Son Canal (irrigating Rohtas, Bhojpur) and Eastern Son Canal (Aurangabad, Gaya, Patna).
questions.tip: Oldest canal system in Bihar = Son Canal System (1874, Dehri-on-Son).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The सोन नदी Canal System was completed in 1874 by constructing an anicut weir across the सोन नदी River at Dehri (Rohtas). It bifurcates into the Western सोन नदी Canal (irrigating Rohtas, Bhojpur) and Eastern सोन नदी Canal (Aurangabad, Gaya, Patna).
questions.tip_hi: Oldest canal system in Bihar = सोन नदी Canal System (1874, Dehri-on-सोन नदी).

questions.en: What is the opening lyric of the official State Song of Bihar (बिहार राज्य गीत) adopted by the Government of Bihar in 2012?
questions.hi: 2012 में बिहार सरकार द्वारा अपनाए गए आधिकारिक बिहार राज्य गीत के प्रारंभिक बोल क्या हैं?
options: जय जय बिहार, जय जय भारत
मेरे भारत के कंठहार, तुझको शत-शत वंदन बिहार
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.answer_text: मेरे भारत के कंठहार, तुझको शत-शत वंदन बिहार
questions.explanation: The State Song of Bihar 'Mere Bharat Ke Kanthhar, Tujhko Shat-Shat Vandan Bihar' was composed by poet Satya Narayan with music composed by Pt. Hari Prasad Chaurasia and Pt. Shivkumar Sharma.
questions.tip: State Song of Bihar = 'Mere Bharat Ke Kanthhar' (Lyrics: Satya Narayan; Music: Chaurasia & Sharma).
options_hi: जय जय बिहार, जय जय भारत
मेरे भारत के कंठहार, तुझको शत-शत वंदन बिहार
उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The State Song of Bihar 'Mere Bharat Ke Kanthhar, Tujhko Shat-Shat Vandan Bihar' was composed by poet Satya Narayan with music composed by Pt. Hari Prasad Chaurasia and Pt. Shivkumar Sharma.
questions.tip_hi: State Song of Bihar = 'Mere Bharat Ke Kanthhar' (Lyrics: Satya Narayan; Music: Chaurasia & Sharma).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: In which year was the first railway line in Bihar opened, connecting Howrah to Raniganj and extended to Rajmahal and Patna?
questions.hi: बिहार में पहली रेलवे लाइन किस वर्ष शुरू की गई थी जो हावड़ा से रानीगंज होते हुए राजमहल और पटना तक विस्तारित हुई थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The East Indian Railway (EIR) line in Bihar was opened in 1860-62, connecting Howrah with Patna (Bankipore) and onward to Mughal Sarai along the Ganga loop line.
questions.tip: First railway in India = 1853 (Bombay-Thane); First railway in Bihar = 1860-62 (East Indian Railway).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The पूर्व Indian Railway (EIR) line in Bihar was opened in 1860-62, connecting Howrah with Patna (Bankipore) and onward to Mughal Sarai along the गंगा नदी loop line.
questions.tip_hi: First railway in India = 1853 (Bombay-Thane); First railway in Bihar = 1860-62 (पूर्व Indian Railway).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: Which ancient Mahajanapada had its capital at Rajgriha (Girivraja), later shifted to Pataliputra by King Udayin?(
questions.hi: किस प्राचीन महाजनपद की राजधानी राजगृह (गिरिव्रज) थी, जिसे बाद में राजा उदयन द्वारा पाटलिपुत्र स्थानांतरित किया गया था?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Magadha was one of the sixteen great Mahajanapadas. Its early capital Girivraja (Rajgir) was fortified by Bimbisara and Ajatashatru. King Udayin (Haryanka dynasty) founded Pataliputra at the confluence of Ganga and Son and shifted the capital there.
questions.tip: Magadha capital shifted to Pataliputra = King Udayin (Haryanka dynasty).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Magadha was one of the sixteen great Mahajanapadas. Its early capital Girivraja (Rajgir) was fortified by Bimbisara and Ajatashatru. King Udayin (Haryanka dynasty) founded Pataliputra at the confluence of गंगा नदी and सोन नदी and shifted the capital there.
questions.tip_hi: Magadha capital shifted to Pataliputra = King Udayin (Haryanka dynasty).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: In a group of 60 people, 35 like tea, 25 like coffee, and 15 like both tea and coffee. How many people in the group like neither tea nor coffee?
questions.hi: 60 व्यक्तियों के समूह में, 35 चाय पसंद करते हैं, 25 कॉफी पसंद करते हैं, और 15 चाय और कॉफी दोनों पसंद करते हैं। समूह में कितने व्यक्ति न तो चाय और न ही कॉफी पसंद करते हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: n(T ∪ C) = n(T) + n(C) - n(T ∩ C) = 35 + 25 - 15 = 45 persons like at least one beverage. Number of persons liking neither = Total - n(T ∪ C) = 60 - 45 = 15.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: n(T ∪ C) = n(T) + n(C) - n(T ∩ C) = 35 + 25 - 15 = 45 persons like at least one beverage. Number of persons liking neither = Total - n(T ∪ C) = 60 - 45 = 15.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: Pointing to a woman, a man says, 'Her mother's only son is my brother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.hi: एक महिला की ओर इशारा करते हुए एक पुरुष कहता है, 'उसकी माँ का एकमात्र पुत्र मेरा भाई है।' वह महिला उस पुरुष से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'Her mother's only son' is the woman's brother. If the woman's brother is the man's brother, then the woman is the man's sister.
questions.tip: Mother's only son = Brother. Woman's brother is man's brother, so the woman is his sister.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: 'Her mother's only सोन नदी' is the woman's brother. If the woman's brother is the man's brother, then the woman is the man's sister.
questions.tip_hi: Mother's only सोन नदी = Brother. Woman's brother is man's brother, so the woman is his sister.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: India's longest rubber dam, the 'Gayaji Dam' on the sacred Falgu River, was inaugurated in September 2022 in which holy city of Bihar?
questions.hi: पवित्र फल्गु नदी पर भारत के सबसे लंबे रबर डैम 'गयाजी डैम' का उद्घाटन सितंबर 2022 में बिहार के किस पावन नगर में किया गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Chief Minister Nitish Kumar inaugurated the 411-metre-long and 3-metre-high 'Gayaji Dam' on the Falgu River near Vishnupad Temple on 8 September 2022 to maintain round-the-year water depth for pilgrims.
questions.tip: India's largest rubber dam = Gayaji Dam on Falgu River (Gaya, 411 m long).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: मुख्यमंत्री Nitish Kumar inaugurated the 411-metre-long and 3-metre-high 'Gayaji Dam' on the Falgu River near Vishnupad Temple on 8 सितम्बर 2022 to maintain round-the-वर्ष water depth for pilgrims.
questions.tip_hi: India's largest rubber dam = Gayaji Dam on Falgu River (Gaya, 411 m long).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: Which two major rivers of peninsular India flow westward through tectonic rift valleys and discharge into the Arabian Sea forming estuaries instead of deltas?(
questions.hi: प्रायद्वीपीय भारत की कौन-सी दो प्रमुख नदियाँ भ्रंश घाटियों (Rift Valleys) से होकर पश्चिम की ओर बहती हैं और डेल्टा के स्थान पर ज्वारनदमुख (Estuary) बनाती हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Narmada and Tapi (Tapti) flow westward through linear graben rift valleys flanked by the Vindhya and Satpura ranges, emptying into the Gulf of Khambhat (Arabian Sea) without forming extensive deltas.
questions.tip: West-flowing rift valley rivers = Narmada & Tapi; Form estuaries, not deltas.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Narmada and Tapi (Tapti) flow westward through linear graben rift valleys flanked by the Vindhya and Satpura ranges, emptying into the Gulf of Khambhat (Arabian Sea) without forming extensive deltas.
questions.tip_hi: पश्चिम-flowing rift valley rivers = Narmada & Tapi; Form estuaries, not deltas.

questions.en: Which two of the following extreme locations are connected by the East-West Corridor?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से दो दूरस्थ स्थान पूर्व-पश्चिम गलियारे से जुड़े हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The East-West Corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral project links Silchar in Assam (East) with Porbandar in Gujarat (West).
questions.tip: Corridors: East-West = Silchar to Porbandar; North-South = Srinagar to Kanyakumari.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The पूर्व-पश्चिम Corridor of the Golden Quadrilateral project links Silchar in Assam (पूर्व) with Porbandar in Gujarat (पश्चिम).
questions.tip_hi: Corridors: पूर्व-पश्चिम = Silchar to Porbandar; उत्तर-दक्षिण = Srinagar to Kanyakumari.

questions.en: Which of the following is not a young fold mountain?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा नवीन वलित पर्वत नहीं है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Aravallis (India) and the Appalachians (North America) are relict/ancient fold mountains formed hundreds of millions of years ago, unlike the young Tertiary fold mountains (Andes, Himalayas).
questions.tip: Young fold mountains: Himalayas, Alps, Andes, Rockies. Old fold mountains: Aravallis, Appalachians, Urals.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The Aravallis (India) and the Appalachians (उत्तर America) are relict/ancient fold mountains formed hundreds of millions of वर्ष ago, unlike the young Tertiary fold mountains (Andes, Himalayas).
questions.tip_hi: Young fold mountains: Himalayas, Alps, Andes, Rockies. Old fold mountains: Aravallis, Appalachians, Urals.

questions.en: Which of the following activities does not belong to the primary sector?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी गतिविधि प्राथमिक क्षेत्र से संबंधित नहीं है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fishing is an extraction activity belonging to the primary sector. Transport and Banking provide commercial services belonging to the tertiary sector. Since two do not belong, (D) is correct.
questions.tip: Primary = Agriculture, Mining, Fishing, Forestry; Secondary = Manufacturing; Tertiary = Transport, Banking, Insurance.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Fishing is an extraction activity belonging to the primary sector. Transport and Banking provide commercial services belonging to the tertiary sector. Since two do not belong, (D) is correct.
questions.tip_hi: Primary = Agriculture, Mining, Fishing, Forestry; Secondary = Manufacturing; Tertiary = Transport, Banking, Insurance.

questions.en: Earth Day celebrated every 22nd April is related with
questions.hi: प्रतिवर्ष 22 अप्रैल को मनाया जाने वाला पृथ्वी दिवस संबंधित है
options: End of the Second World War day
Declaration of no use of nuclear weapons on earth planet
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Earth Day was first organized on April 22, 1970 in the USA by Senator Gaylord Nelson to mobilize grassroots public education and action on environmental conservation.
questions.tip: Earth Day focuses on global environmental protection and climate awareness, rejecting misleading wartime or disarmament distractors.

questions.en: Which of the following is the source of renewable energy?
questions.hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा का स्रोत है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Coal and Petroleum are exhaustible fossil fuels, while Nuclear fuel (Uranium/Thorium) is a non-renewable finite mineral. As none is renewable, (E) is the answer.
questions.tip: Renewable = Solar, Wind, Hydro, Biomass, Geothermal. Coal, oil, natural gas, and uranium are non-renewable.

questions.en:
In which of the following States of India, the maximum teak forest is found?
(
questions.hi: भारत के निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य में सर्वाधिक सागौन (teak) वन पाए जाते हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Madhya Pradesh contains the largest area under teak (Tectona grandis) forests in India, covering extensive tracts in Hoshangabad, Betul, and Jabalpur.
questions.tip: Teak (सागौन) and Sal (साल) are predominant species of tropical deciduous forests; MP possesses the largest teak forest area.

questions.en: Kargil is located on the bank of
questions.hi: कारगिल किस नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The city and district of Kargil in Ladakh are situated along the banks of the Suru River, a significant left-bank tributary of the Indus River.
questions.tip: Leh is located on the Indus River; Kargil is located on the Suru River; Srinagar is located on the Jhelum River.

questions.en:
Which of the following is suitable for alcoholic beverages?
(
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन मादक पेय (alcoholic beverages) के लिए उपयुक्त है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ethanol (ethyl alcohol, C2H5OH) is the psychoactive substance suitable for potable alcoholic beverages. Methanol (methyl alcohol, CH3OH) is highly poisonous.
questions.tip: Potable drinking alcohol = Ethanol (C2H5OH); Toxic industrial alcohol = Methanol (CH3OH, causes blindness and death).

questions.en: The author of the book, 'The Chipko Movement: A People's History' is
questions.hi: 'द चिपको मूवमेंट: ए पीपुल्स हिस्ट्री' पुस्तक के लेखक हैं
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Historian Shekhar Pathak authored 'The Chipko Movement: A People's History' (translated by Manisha Chaudhry), which won the Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF Book Prize 2022.
questions.tip: Award-winning environmental history books are heavily tested in BPSC General Studies.
